content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Mangalagiri Research Associate III Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 20-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Mangalagiri, Andhra Pradesh (AIIMS Mangalagiri) for filling up research positions under the Department of Health Research.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The position available in this recruitment drive is Research Associate III under the Department of Health Research, ICMR, MOHFW on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate III post in this recruitment notification released by AIIMS Mangalagiri.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 20-10-2026 by 5.00 PM to the designated official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in and document verification date?
faq.answer: The walk-in and document verification for the shortlisted or eligible candidates participating in this recruitment process is scheduled for 27-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Research Associate III post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate III position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 67,000 along with HRA as applicable (20%).

faq.question: Q7. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in Public Health/Epidemiology/Statistics/Environmental Sciences/Population Sciences/Demography/Health Economics/HTA/Pharmacy with 3 years post PG experience, or MD/MS/MDS or PhD.

faq.question: Q8. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Research Associate III position is 40 years, with possible relaxations for experienced government research candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted online via email by sending the filled application form and supporting documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website details?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official AIIMS Mangalagiri website at www.aiimsmangalagiri.edu.in to access all updates, notifications, and detailed guidelines regarding the recruitment process.
